Model deletion samples (SKILL.md:286-287, examples.md:453-454) affect the user's Azure resource only when their code runs. The ID-document sample processes personal data (names, DOB, document numbers). SKILL.md:31 has an XML comment label inside the Maven fence, not hidden instructions.
